nota: Receta del paquete de efectos: los 20 primeros son los de interfaz de la plantilla y los 14 siguientes, de objetos y ambiente (intro 3D, 0.3.0). Genéralo con scripts/paquete_efectos.py y tu clave de ElevenLabs: el paquete no se distribuye, porque los términos de ElevenLabs no permiten repartir lo generado. El tecleo se corta en 8 teclas (tecla0-tecla7). Familias y cribas en references/sonido.md.

ui-click.prompt: Soft modern mouse click on a trackpad, short clean interface click, no reverb, one-shot

slice.prompt: Fast crisp digital slice swish, a clean blade cutting through air, short and bright, no metallic ring, one-shot

card-in.prompt: Short soft airy whoosh of a card sliding in, modern app interface transition, gentle, no low rumble, one-shot

zoom.prompt: Smooth airy camera zoom-in whoosh, modern motion graphics transition, clean, no low rumble, one-shot

pop.prompt: Tiny soft bubbly interface pop, short and gentle, clean, one-shot

success.prompt: Soft pleasant two-note interface confirmation chime, warm and short, clean, no reverb tail, one-shot

rechazo.prompt: Soft muted two-note descending interface notice tone, gentle and calm, short, clean, no reverb, one-shot

sello.prompt: Firm soft rubber stamp pressed on paper on a desk, short and clean, one-shot

publicado.prompt: Soft short friendly phone notification blip, modern app, clean, no reverb tail, one-shot

enviar.prompt: Short soft whoosh of a chat message being sent in a modern messaging app, light and clean, one-shot

soltar.prompt: Soft muffled thump of a file dropped into an app upload area, short clean interface sound, gentle, one-shot

transicion.prompt: Smooth wide airy whoosh for a scene transition in a modern product video, clean, soft attack, no low rumble, one-shot

paper-plane.prompt: Quick paper fold crinkle followed by a light airy whoosh of a paper plane flying away, clean, one-shot

logo-hit.prompt: Deep soft cinematic impact with a short warm tail, modern logo reveal hit, clean, not boomy, one-shot

magia.prompt: Magical sparkle shimmer, a quick bright twinkle of tiny bells and glitter over a soft airy whoosh, clean, short, one-shot

monedas.prompt: A burst of gold coins tumbling and clinking together, bright cheerful cascade, close and clean, no music, one-shot

giro.prompt: Fast swirling whoosh of a phone flipping in the air, quick spin swish, clean modern motion graphics, no low rumble, one-shot

scroll.prompt: Rapid swipe flicks of a phone feed scrolling faster and faster, airy clean whooshes that speed up, modern interface, no music

asombro.prompt: Bright cinematic impact with a shimmering sparkle tail, a wow reveal moment in a product video, clean, not boomy, one-shot

teclado.prompt: Fast natural typing on a quiet modern laptop keyboard, about fourteen crisp separate key presses with tiny pauses, close and dry, no music, no voice

aire.prompt: Continuous soft airy wind movement, like a smooth camera gliding through open space, gentle steady whoosh texture, no tones, no rumble, seamless loop

ambiente.prompt: Busy small restaurant dining room ambience, distant indistinct chatter, cutlery and plates clinking, slightly muffled, no music, no clear words

riser.prompt: Fast tense rising whoosh swell building up energy, cinematic riser with airy shimmer, ending abruptly at its peak, clean, no rumble

golpe.prompt: Punchy deep cinematic impact thump with a short tight tail, modern motion graphics hit, warm low body, not distorted, one-shot

porcelana.prompt: A small solid ceramic marble dropped onto a glazed porcelain tabletop, single crisp bright clack, close, dry, no reverb, one-shot

toque.prompt: A small ceramic marble gently tapping a smartphone glass screen, single soft glassy tick, close, dry, no reverb, one-shot

rodar.prompt: A heavy ceramic marble rolling quickly across a smooth porcelain table, continuous smooth rolling with a slight clatter, close, no reverb

bisagra.prompt: A laptop lid being opened smoothly, soft hinge friction and a gentle click at the end, close, quiet room, no reverb

contador.prompt: Fast digital counter numbers rolling up, rapid soft clicking ticks accelerating then stopping, modern finance app, clean, no music

tinta.prompt: Thick dark ink wave sweeping across the whole screen, deep smooth swoosh with a soft liquid swell, cinematic transition, no splash, no rumble

deslizar.prompt: Papers and a notebook quickly swept off a smooth table, short sliding whoosh with paper rustle, clean, no rumble

succion.prompt: Reverse whoosh sucking in, a quick reversed cymbal swell rising into a hit, clean, ending sharply at the peak

boton.prompt: Satisfying chunky tactile button press, deep soft click with a tiny thump, modern app interface, one-shot

vibra.prompt: Short smartphone vibration buzz on a wooden table, two quick soft buzzes, close, dry, no ringtone, no music, one-shot
